name: Shotcandy
one_liner: Paste a plain screenshot and get a share-ready image in seconds — free, in the browser.

text.why: Dressing up a product screenshot for social posts or slides by hand is tedious. Shotcandy shows the styled result the moment you paste, and every style preview uses your own image rather than a sample.
text.take: Similar services usually add a watermark or lock styles behind a paywall; this one is fully free and MIT-licensed.
build: It runs entirely in the browser, so nothing is uploaded. Screen recordings become share-ready videos too. No account, no paywall, no watermark.

who.role: Marketers, designers and solo founders who share product screenshots often.

start.text: Open shotcandy.app and paste a screenshot (⌘V on a Mac).

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: Shotcandy before and after: a plain dashboard screenshot on the left, restyled on an orange background at an angle on the right.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
